nodes.Name: isNaN
nodes.DocComment: isNaN reports whether f is an IEEE 754 “not-a-number” value.

nodes.Name: isFinite
nodes.DocComment: isFinite reports whether f is neither NaN nor an infinity.

nodes.Name: isInf
nodes.DocComment: isInf reports whether f is an infinity.

nodes.Name: abs
nodes.DocComment:
abs returns the absolute value of x.

Special cases are:

	abs(±Inf) = +Inf
	abs(NaN) = NaN

nodes.Name: copysign
nodes.DocComment:
copysign returns a value with the magnitude
of x and the sign of y.

nodes.Name: float64bits
nodes.DocComment: float64bits returns the IEEE 754 binary representation of f.

nodes.Name: float64frombits
nodes.DocComment:
float64frombits returns the floating point number corresponding
the IEEE 754 binary representation b.

nodes.Name: floor
nodes.DocComment:
floor returns the greatest integer value less than or equal to x.

Special cases are:

	floor(±0) = ±0
	floor(±Inf) = ±Inf
	floor(NaN) = NaN

N.B. Portable floor copied from math. math also has optimized arch-specific
implementations.

nodes.Name: ceil
nodes.DocComment:
ceil returns the least integer value greater than or equal to x.

Special cases are:

	Ceil(±0) = ±0
	Ceil(±Inf) = ±Inf
	Ceil(NaN) = NaN

N.B. Portable ceil copied from math. math also has optimized arch-specific
implementations.

nodes.Name: modf
nodes.DocComment:
modf returns integer and fractional floating-point numbers
that sum to f. Both values have the same sign as f.

Special cases are:

	Modf(±Inf) = ±Inf, NaN
	Modf(NaN) = NaN, NaN

N.B. Portable modf copied from math. math also has optimized arch-specific
implementations.
